svg.title: cd capabilities
svg.desc: Class diagram of capabilities. AiNative: harness(agents), mcpServer(apis, data), skill(teamStandards), govern(security, privacy), train(teams). Integration: eip(camel, quarkus), stream(kafka, cdc), modernize(stranglerFig), connect(payments, gov). Architecture: design(ddd, hexagonal, cqrs), decide(adr), scale(webflux, vthreads), native(graalvm). Delivery: fullStack(java, node), platform(backstage, tf), observe(otel, grafana), test(k6, chaos), lead(teams, mentoring).
